about: Packages whose published advisories are known and waited on, each until a date. After the date the audit check fails again. See tools/lib_audit.js.

waivers.reason: GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579 (fixed in 6.4.1) is in the attribution control, which writes attribution text as HTML. The app creates its map with attributionControl: false (lib/vtmap.js) and uses no popups, so that code never runs here. 4.7.1 to 6.x is a major upgrade to plan and test.
